integrity: Mathematical arguments and verification code are self-contained; numerical checks do not replace the proof. Scientific authorship, publication priority, and independent certification are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exponentially decaying path law does not claim the same asymptotic for arbitrary graph sequences.
The linear-operation forest algorithm counts arithmetic operations rather than integer bit complexity.
Computational enumeration is finite; arbitrary graph validity is proved mathematically.
Earlier equivalent representations as graph-spin partition functions are not conclusively excluded.
title: Four-state partition formula and exponential prelinearity decay on graph-incidence Heyting frames
